package flowexperiment

import (
	"context"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/contracts"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/dimen"
	"github.com/npillmayer/khipu/helpers"
	"github.com/npillmayer/typography/glyphing/paragraph"
	"github.com/npillmayer/uax/bidi"
)

// Each word is 10 bp and a space is 5 bp with no shrink. Enumerating this tiny
// example independently prevents shared reference/resume mistakes from passing.
func TestE2IndependentBreakOracle(t *testing.T) {
	p, seed, _ := flowSeed(t, textInput("aa bb cc dd ee ff gg hh ii jj kk ll"), flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit))
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(seed.Initial().BreakPositions, []uint64{9, 18, 27, 35}) {
		t.Fatal("initial oracle changed", seed.Initial().BreakPositions)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		width dimen.DU
		want  []uint64
	}{
		{20, []uint64{9, 12, 15, 18, 21, 24, 27, 30, 33, 35}},
		{30, []uint64{9, 15, 21, 27, 33, 35}},
		{55, []uint64{9, 21, 33, 35}},
	} {
		for _, resume := range []bool{false, true} {
			got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, 10, tc.width*dimen.BP, 1000, resume)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(got.result.BreakPositions, tc.want) {
				t.Fatal("independent oracle", tc.width, resume, got.result.BreakPositions, tc.want)
			}
		}
	}
}

func TestE2ContextHeightAndObjects(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, text string
		dir        bidi.Direction
		factor     float64
	}{
		{"RTL", "אב גד הו זח טי כל מנ ס", bidi.RightToLeft, 1},
		{"mixed isolate", "abc \u2067אב 12 גד הו\u2069 (xyz) dd ee ff", bidi.LeftToRight, 1},
		{"forced and trimmed", "  aa bb\n\ncc dd ee ff  ", bidi.LeftToRight, 1},
		{"signed leading", "aa bb cc dd ee ff gg hh", bidi.LeftToRight, .25},
		{"fractional", "aa bb cc dd ee ff gg hh", bidi.LeftToRight, .731},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			input := textInput(tc.text)
			input.Direction = tc.dir
			req := flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit)
			req.Params.LineLayout.Default.Factor = tc.factor
			p, seed, c := flowSeed(t, input, req)
			initial := seed.Initial()
			ha := initial.VList.Lines()[0].Height
			before := c.snapshot()
			ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, false)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, true)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			compareFlow(t, initial, ref, got, 1, 30*dimen.BP)
			noBaseShaping(t, before, c.snapshot())
			if tc.name == "RTL" {
				// Physical left-to-right knot traversal reverses all-RTL logical words.
				pairs := 0
				for _, l := range got.b.Lines() {
					previous := uint64(^uint64(0))
					count := 0
					for i := l.Horizontal.FirstKnot; i < l.Horizontal.FirstKnot+l.Horizontal.KnotCount; i++ {
						k, _ := got.b.Frozen().Knot(i)
						if k.Kind != khipu.KTTextBox {
							continue
						}
						if k.Source.Bytes.Start >= previous {
							t.Fatal("suffix wasn't reordered per line")
						}
						previous = k.Source.Bytes.Start
						count++
					}
					if count > 1 {
						pairs++
					}
				}
				if pairs == 0 {
					t.Fatal("missing RTL multiword suffix oracle")
				}
			}
		})
	}
	for _, dir := range []bidi.Direction{bidi.LeftToRight, bidi.RightToLeft} {
		input := textInput("aa\n\uFFFC\uFFFC aa bb cc dd ee\n\uFFFC")
		input.Direction = dir
		input.Atomics = []contracts.AtomicAnchor{{ID: 7, ByteOffset: 3}, {ID: 2, ByteOffset: 6}, {ID: 9, ByteOffset: 25}}
		req := flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit)
		req.Atomics = []paragraph.AtomicBox{
			{ID: 7, Margin: paragraph.AtomicMargins{Right: -2 * dimen.BP}, Alignment: paragraph.AlignBottomMarginEdge},
			{ID: 2, BorderWidth: 4 * dimen.BP, BorderHeight: 30 * dimen.BP, Margin: paragraph.AtomicMargins{Left: -2 * dimen.BP}, Alignment: paragraph.AlignBottomMarginEdge},
			{ID: 9, Alignment: paragraph.AlignBottomMarginEdge},
		}
		p, seed, c := flowSeed(t, input, req)
		before := c.snapshot()
		ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, 10, 30*dimen.BP, 32, false)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, 10, 30*dimen.BP, 32, true)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		compareFlow(t, seed.Initial(), ref, got, 1, 30*dimen.BP)
		if len(got.b.Lines()) != 1 || got.b.Lines()[0].Height != 32 || got.status != moreFrames {
			t.Fatal("lost full atomic height/tail")
		}
		noBaseShaping(t, before, c.snapshot())
	}
}

// The fake shaper accepts feature metadata without implementing a feature's
// rendering effect. Retained contexts must still keep the original run domain.
type flowFeatureStream struct{ countedStream }

func (s flowFeatureStream) Shape(ctx context.Context, p contracts.ShapeParams, r contracts.RuneReader, o contracts.ShapeBufferOptions) error {
	p.Features = nil
	return s.countedStream.Shape(ctx, p, r, o)
}
func TestE2FeatureDomainsAndMixedSizes(t *testing.T) {
	c := new(serviceCalls)
	cfg := flowConfig(c)
	cfg.Streaming.Defaults.Features = []contracts.ShapeFeature{{Tag: [4]byte{'l', 'i', 'g', 'a'}, Enabled: true, Value: 1, Start: 2, End: 10}}
	cfg.Streaming.NewShaper = func() (contracts.StreamingShaper, error) {
		c.hit(1)
		s, e := helpers.NewSyntheticStreamingShaper(8)
		return flowFeatureStream{countedStream{s, c}}, e
	}
	input := textInput("aa bb cc dd ee ff gg hh ii jj")
	p, err := paragraph.Prepare(t.Context(), input, khipu.PrepareOptions{}, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	seed, err := p.FlowStart(t.Context(), flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	before := c.snapshot()
	ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, 10, 20*dimen.BP, 1000, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, 10, 20*dimen.BP, 1000, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	compareFlow(t, seed.Initial(), ref, got, 1, 20*dimen.BP)
	seen := false
	for _, l := range got.b.Lines() {
		for k := l.Horizontal.FirstKnot; k < l.Horizontal.FirstKnot+l.Horizontal.KnotCount; k++ {
			tx, ok := got.b.Frozen().CopyText(k)
			if ok && len(tx.Context.Params.Features) > 0 {
				seen = true
				if tx.Context.Params.Features[0].Start != 2 || tx.Context.Params.Features[0].End != 10 || tx.Context.Input.Bytes.Start != 0 {
					t.Fatal("feature domain rebased to suffix")
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if !seen {
		t.Fatal("feature fixture missing")
	}
	noBaseShaping(t, before, c.snapshot())

	input = textInput("aa\ncc dd ee ff gg hh")
	input.Text, err = input.Text.Style(sized(20*dimen.BP), 3, input.Text.Raw().Len())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req := flowRequest(paragraph.FirstFit)
	req.Params.Constraints.Width = 80 * dimen.BP
	p, seed, c = flowSeed(t, input, req)
	before = c.snapshot()
	ref, err = flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, 10, 40*dimen.BP, 20, false)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	got, err = flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, 10, 40*dimen.BP, 20, true)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	compareFlow(t, seed.Initial(), ref, got, 1, 40*dimen.BP)
	if len(got.b.Lines()) != 1 || got.b.Lines()[0].Height != 20 || got.status != moreFrames {
		t.Fatal("mixed size space/height lost")
	}
	noBaseShaping(t, before, c.snapshot())
}

func TestE2RetainedMarkupAndDefaultSkips(t *testing.T) {
	for _, breaker := range []paragraph.Breaker{paragraph.FirstFit, paragraph.KnuthPlass} {
		input := textInput("aa bb \uFFFC אב גד הו זח טי כל מנ")
		input.Atomics = []contracts.AtomicAnchor{{ID: 1, ByteOffset: 6}}
		markupCalls := 0
		input.Markup = func(at uint64) int {
			markupCalls++
			if at == 10 {
				return bidi.MarkupRLI
			}
			if at == input.Text.Raw().Len() {
				return bidi.MarkupPDI
			}
			return 0
		}
		req := flowRequest(breaker)
		req.Params.Constraints.Width = 60 * dimen.BP
		req.Horizontal = nil
		req.Atomics = []paragraph.AtomicBox{{ID: 1, BorderWidth: 5 * dimen.BP, BorderHeight: 22 * dimen.BP, Alignment: paragraph.AlignBottomMarginEdge}}
		p, seed, c := flowSeed(t, input, req)
		initial := seed.Initial()
		calls := markupCalls
		before := c.snapshot()
		if calls == 0 || len(initial.VList.Lines()) < 2 {
			t.Fatal("missing markup/suffix fixture")
		}
		req.Atomics[0].BorderHeight = dimen.Infinity
		req.Params.LineLayout.Default.Factor = 99
		ha := initial.VList.Lines()[0].Height
		ref, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, false)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got, err := flowToFrames(t.Context(), p, seed, ha, 30*dimen.BP, 1000, true)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		compareFlow(t, initial, ref, got, 1, 30*dimen.BP)
		if markupCalls != calls {
			t.Fatal("paragraph bidi/markup prepared again")
		}
		noBaseShaping(t, before, c.snapshot())
	}
}
